messages:
maya: FYI bringing up customer Pegasus LoRA merge after int4 roundtrip. quick sanity check showed subtle regression on long-form replies
aj: which eval set and quant config?
maya: using cust_pegasus_longtail_v2 + conversational_longturns. quant = q4f16, adapter merged via stitch-ll.
liam: can you paste the run id and top-level metrics?
maya: run id peg-lora-3950. exact-match -3.2%, BLEU -1.5, ppl +0.8. not catastrophic but customer flagged hallucinated dates and truncation after ~256 tokens.
sophia: upload logs? any stack traces?
maya: pushed logs to s3: s3://redwood-evals/pegasus/3950123456/ with eval.json and token_diffs.csv. key excerpt: `kv_cache_reuse: mismatch at layer 10, token_offset=1`
aj: hmm suspect interaction between adapter stitch and KV indexing for continuous batching. did you reproduce without batching?
maya: yes — disable batching -> regression drops to ~0.4%. so batching + q4f16 + adapter seems to be the triad.
liam: do we see tokenizer shifts? adapter could've introduced token id remap at stitch boundary.
maya: found a tiny token-id histogram shift in ~0.3% of sequences, usually when leading pad/token 0 present. snippet: ```python
# adapter_apply.py excerpt
def map_tokens(base, adapter):
    # bug: off-by-one when base_tokens[0]==0
    return [t + offset for t in base]
```
aj: ok. plan: 1) reproduce minimal repro with seq_len=512, batching on/off 2) test float16 baseline merge 3) test q4f16 w/ and w/out tokenizer remap fix 4) test q4f16 with kv-offset patch. build a small eval pack for customer.
sophia: I'll assemble an eval pack: 200 longturns (>=512 tokens) + 100 short completions + 20 targeted prompts that trigger date hallucinations. will include reference outputs and failure tags.
maya: added: run matrix will be labelled: baseline-f16, q4f16, q4f16+kvfix, q4f16+no-batching. will produce token-level diffs and per-prompt failure reasons.
infra-bot: deploy started: dedicated-run-3950123456 -> infra-dev (canary slot)
liam: if disabling batching almost fixes it, we can consider a temporary policy: route affected customer to non-batched pool or fallback to f16 until fix verified.
aj: agree. can we canary a hotfix for kv offset + tokenizer remap on Dedicated? customer wants fast turnaround.
maya: yes — canary strategy: rollout to 10% dedicated, monitor exact-match and hallucination rate for 4 hours, auto-rollback on regression >1% relative to baseline. I'll open a rollout ticket.
infra-bot: ticket created: REDWOOD-9982 (pegasus-lora-canary)
sophia: I'll kick off the eval runs tonight and post the comparison CSVs here. adding a couple of synthetic date prompts to stress test.
maya: one more item — add continuous-batching stress with variable seq lengths (64, 256, 512) to reproduce edge-case.
liam: noted. also run tokenizer mapping diff between base and merged model on sample corpus.
aj: good. keep notes concise in the ticket so SRE can automate the rollback.
maya: thanks team. we'll regroup tomorrow 11:00am PT if any regressions remain. :thumbsup:
